text: پیام بدی یا صبر کنی؟ بعد از یه قرار خوب
rationale: The film's own opening line is the strongest and most honest hook: it asks the question the viewer has lived, in the order it is set on screen (claim above, qualifier below), and claims nothing the narration does not say. Result-led candidates score lower for giving the turn away; the figure-led candidate front-loads the study instead of the viewer.
